recipes.name: Meatloaf with Fried Onions and Ranch Seasoning
ingredients_raw: 0.75 cup herb-seasoned dry bread stuffing mix
0.5 (1 ounce) package dry Ranch-style dressing mix

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a large bowl, combine meat, eggs, ketchup, stuffing mix, ranch dressing mix, and fried onions.
Shape into loaf and fit into a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Bake, covered loosely with foil about 50 to 60 minutes, or until meat is thoroughly cooked.

raw_recipe.headline: Meatloaf with Fried Onions and Ranch Seasoning
raw_recipe.description: This belongs in your repertoire of quick dinner menus. Herb-seasoned stuffing mix, ranch seasoning for dips, and packaged fried onions make it a snap to prepare.

review.reviewBody:
My husband and I loved this recipe we have tried several different ones and I think that this is going to be "the one" we will go back to.. The only changes I made were I added in some garlic powder and just a splash of worchestire sauce.. For a glaze I added a mix of ketchup and Heinz 57 and then sprinkled some shredded mozarella cheese on top when it came out of the oven..DELICIOUS!!! 
Kiki (Brampton,Ont,Canada)

I already love meatloaf but this recipe my husband loved as well! I made a few minor changes based on reviews and what I had on hand - I used 2 lbs meat instead of 1.5 lb, simply because that is how it came in the package... I used the cheddar fried onions but couldn't discern any separate cheddar taste so we will just go with the regular onions next time - I really do like them as a filler, and if you get the store brand, the cost is not so much an issue. I did not have herb stuffing mix so I had to use italian seasoned bread crumbs. I want to try it with the stuffing because I like those bites of bread in the loaf. ^-^ Since there was an extra .5 lb meat, I kept the rest of the ingredients the same and added some liquid smoke (hickory) and 1/3 cup 57 sauce to the meat and then when I shaped the loaf I put a little trench in the top and put some sauce in there too. We cooked in a covered roasting pan with potatoes and carrots. I was AMAZED that my husband liked it. The leftovers were gone by the next day! This will be our new recipe for meatloaf as I love it and can now make it more often as hubby will eat it too! Thank you VERY much for sharing!

Good meatloaf that everyone at the table enjoyed. Doubled the recipe for leftovers (cold meatloaf sandwiches are the best). I baked mine open in the oven instead of using a bread pan. It makes the crust a bit thicker and adds to the flavoring. I used cornbread stuffing as that's what was available at the time and generously sprinkled "Buck's Seasoning" on the outside of the two meat loafs before placing into the oven. This family will certainly add this recipe to the rotation. Yum Delicious!!!!

Whisking together the ingredients PRIOR to mixing in with the ground beef will naturally THICKEN and help bind the loaf nicely for baking--DO NOT THIN OUT W/ WATER. Made this a 2nd time as per directions: WONDERFUL comfort food--nice for early Fall season! And my 3rd time w/ this recipe, I added shredded cheese, sliced mushrooms, diced green and red peppers--and earned the 5th star!!

This is a great recipe! My husbands and I favorite meatloaf. The only thing I change is I add Worcestershire sauce. We make the night before, refrigerate overnight and slice it up and cook on the grill with our favorite bbq sauce to "blacken"it. It is fantastic!

Ice been making this for over a decade now. I do lb beef and 1/2 lb ground pork. I season with seasoning salt pepper garlic powder. I also use almost whole packet of ranch seasoning. I also sometimes add bell pepper if on hand. FOR glaze I mix up ketchup lemon juice s&p and brown sugar Which i top loaf with on last 10-15 mins

Interesting mix of ingredients which is what led me to try it, but I felt this recipe was nothing exceptional and surprisingly rather bland.... The only thing that saved it was my go to recipe for a meatloaf glaze: 3 tablespoons ketchup, 1.5 tablespoons honey and 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire. Thank you Stephanie for the submission.

Very good recipe. I took a few tips from several reviewer. I used 2lbs. of ground beef, 3 eggs, a whole box of stuffing, the whole pkg. of ranch dressing, 2 med. onions, sauteed, and added some garlic, salt and pepper. It seemed a bit gooey, so I added some oatmeal. And to top it, I spread mixed with brown sugar, ketchup and HP sauce . Thanks for all the hints...it made two loafs, and it turned out to be a huge hit.

I agree that this meatloaf needs some kick. I added a topping that I found from Mary's Meatloaf on this site. It is 1/4 cup ketchup, 1TBS Yellow Mustard, 3TBS Brown sugar. With the topping I don't think you need to change anything else. I did have to cook an extra 15 mins at 400 degrees for an internal temperature of 165. I also drained about a cup of grease from the pan and it was still plenty moist.

This was DELICIOUS!!!! I used 2 lbs of meat (1 lb 80% and the 2nd 95%), a full ranch packet, bbq sauce, worchestire sauce, garlic, and half an onion and green pepper (in food processor)....along with all of the normal ingredients! I split the bowl and froze half for a quick dinner some night! I am very picky over meatloaf and try all sorts of recipes. This was by far one of the best!!! My husband loved it too.

so I have never been a meatloaf fan, however this is the first recipe that I have wanted to go back for seconds! I modified it a bit. I added 1/4C randch dressing and ommited one egg in it's place. I also crushed up extra FF onions and coated the top to make a like a crust...mmmm!! Thank you for such a great recipe, this will be my go to meatloaf!!
This was an easy and quick recipe. The family thought it was good but not their favorite meatloaf recipe that has fresh onions, carrot, and cheese in it.

This recipe makes the best meatloaf. The whole family loves it. I’ve been making this for years. I add quite a few shakes of Worcestershire - pretty generous, and also add some steak sauce a few tablespoons ish- then use a tad less of the ketchup to make up for the added steak sauce and Worcestershire . I top with 50/50 steak sauce and barbecue sauce/ and sometimes top with sprinkle of cheese. Thanks for sharing it with us- I’d been making years before reviewing.
Excellent!!! Every one loved it. Followed recipe no changes.

I've made this so many times and it has never disappointed. I've done it exactly as it says, and I've added garlic, swopped out the crackers for breadcrumbs, great either way. Superbly scrumptious meatloaf!!!!!
I have been making this recipe for years and my family LOVES it! I have tried a few others over this time and none of them even remotely compare to this recipe.

This turned out OK but it was a little to bulky for my tastes. I may try it again with about half of the fried onions. I also think it could use a little kick from something like a little soy or worscheister. Just my opinion, thanks for it though.
Pretty good but a little disappointed that I couldn't really taste the stuffing mix. I also used some bottled ranch dressing instead and some pepper.
My all time favorite meatloaf, the only change I made was adding more croutons
Now this is the Stuff Meatloaf is made from! Yummy!
